Part Description: USB 3.0 to 10/100/1000 Ethernet controller, QFN-40 5x5 mm, 0.4 mm pitch, exposed pad (pin 41). Pin 1 at the lower right of the part as seen from the front of the board.
25 MHz crystal, CL 18 pF, 3225 4-pad. No fixed pin-1 mark (see ORDERING.md): align the long axis of the body with the long axis of the pads. Pads 1 and 3 are the terminals, 2 and 4 are ground.
Distributor: DigiKey or Mouser by manufacturer part number
